# API reference

<!-- Generated by internal/apidoc from the packages' doc comments: edit those, then run `task docs:api`. -->

Every exported name of every public package of limes and its nested
modules, by concern, with its declaration and its doc comment — which is
its specification: what it accepts, refuses and returns
([compatibility.md](../compatibility.md)). Each category is a file of its
own; a heading names a declaration as `package.Name`, and a method or a
constructor as `package.Type.Name`, so a search for either across this
directory finds it. The error codes, their HTTP status and category are in
[errors.md](../errors.md); every default and limit is in
[defaults.md](../defaults.md); how the pieces are used together is in the
[guide](../guide.md).

## Categories

| Category | Packages | |
|---|---|---|
| [Capabilities and caveats](capabilities.md) | `limes` | What a capability is and carries: its principal, its caveats, its amounts and ceilings, and the checks an operation is held to. |
| [Issuing, delegating and signing](issuing.md) | `limes` | Minting a capability, narrowing it for a delegate, and the keys and signers behind both. |
| [Verifying and authorizing](verifying.md) | `limes` | Checking a presented token and authorizing a call with it. |
| [Inspecting a token](inspection.md) | `inspect` | Reading a token without trusting it, for debugging. |
| [Proof of possession (DPoP)](dpop.md) | `dpop` · `redisreplay` | Binding a capability to a key (RFC 9449): proofs, nonces and the replay caches. |
| [Keys and JWKS](keys.md) | `jwks` | Publishing the signing keys and resolving another issuer's (RFC 7517). |
| [Biscuit](biscuit.md) | `limes` · `biscuit` | The Biscuit form of a capability, which its holder attenuates offline. |
| [Revocation](revocation.md) | `limes` | Revoking capabilities, one, by match or a Biscuit copy, and caching the answer. |
| [Metering](metering.md) | `meter` | Request limits, budgets, holds, leases, the ledger and tenant ceilings. |
| [Token exchange](exchange.md) | `exchange` · `jwtverify` | Exchanging an identity provider's token for a capability (RFC 8693). |
| [Storage](storage.md) | `limes` · `memstore` · `pgstore` · `migrate` · `ddl` | The store contracts and the stores limes ships: in memory and PostgreSQL. |
| [Errors and refusals](errors.md) | `limes` | Error codes, categories and reasons, and answering a refusal over HTTP. docs/errors.md holds the tables. |
| [Observing](observing.md) | `limes` · `otelmetric` | Events the issuer, verifier, revoker and stores report, and their OpenTelemetry instruments. |
| [Conformance suites](conformance.md) | `limestest` · `storetest` · `metertest` · `dpoptest` · `jwkstest` · `exchangetest` | Test suites a store, cache or consumer of yours runs to prove it keeps the contract. |

## Packages

| Package | Module | Categories | |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes`](capabilities.md#package-limes) | `limes` | [Capabilities and caveats](capabilities.md) · [Issuing, delegating and signing](issuing.md) · [Verifying and authorizing](verifying.md) · [Biscuit](biscuit.md) · [Revocation](revocation.md) · [Storage](storage.md) · [Errors and refusals](errors.md) · [Observing](observing.md) | Package limes is an object-capability authorisation primitive designed for agentic workloads. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/inspect`](inspection.md#package-inspect) | `limes` | [Inspecting a token](inspection.md) | Package inspect reads a capability token for tooling — a CLI that shows a token, a debugger, a log viewer — without verifying it. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/dpop`](dpop.md#package-dpop) | `limes` | [Proof of possession (DPoP)](dpop.md) | Package dpop implements proof of possession after RFC 9449 (DPoP): a client signs a short JWT over each request with a key it holds, and a server checks the proof against the key a token is bound to. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/redisreplay`](dpop.md#package-redisreplay) | `redisreplay` | [Proof of possession (DPoP)](dpop.md) | Package redisreplay is a dpop.ReplayCache over Redis, for a verifier that runs as several replicas: a proof replayed against any of them is refused, which an in-process dpop.MemoryReplayCache cannot promise. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/jwks`](keys.md#package-jwks) | `limes` | [Keys and JWKS](keys.md) | Package jwks publishes and resolves the Ed25519 keys capability tokens are signed with, as an RFC 7517 JSON Web Key Set. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/biscuit`](biscuit.md#package-biscuit) | `biscuit` | [Biscuit](biscuit.md) | Package biscuit is the Biscuit form of a limes capability token: a Biscuit v3 whose authority block seals the JWT an issuer signed, and whose attenuation blocks its holder appends offline (Attenuate). |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/meter`](metering.md#package-meter) | `limes` | [Metering](metering.md) | Package meter counts what a verified capability uses — requests and spend, against the capability's ceilings, its ancestors', its Biscuit copies' and its tenant's — and keeps the charges ledger, for billing and reports. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/exchange`](exchange.md#package-exchange) | `exchange` | [Token exchange](exchange.md) | Package exchange exchanges an identity provider's access token for a limes capability, by OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693), as docs/adr/0003-oauth-token-exchange.md decides. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/exchange/jwtverify`](exchange.md#package-jwtverify) | `exchange` | [Token exchange](exchange.md) | Package jwtverify verifies JWT access tokens (RFC 9068) as an exchange.SubjectVerifier, through jwx: the library that implements the format, as no identity provider's SDK covers every provider. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/memstore`](storage.md#package-memstore) | `limes` | [Storage](storage.md) | Package memstore is an in-memory reference implementation of the limes storage contracts. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/pgstore`](storage.md#package-pgstore) | `pgstore` | [Storage](storage.md) | Package pgstore is the reference implementation of the limes storage contracts over PostgreSQL: limes.Store, limes.BiscuitRevocationStore, limes.RevocationLineageLookup and limes.BulkRevoker for capability records and revocations, limes.ExchangeStore for token exchange, meter.UsageStore, meter.CopyUsageReader, meter.Leaser, meter.MatchingReleaser and meter.TenantReservationLister for the meter, meter.LedgerReader, limes.RecordCensus, limes.RecordLister and limes.RecordListingReader for reports, meter.LedgerHousekeeping for bounding the ledger, limes.TenantRecordEraser and meter.TenantUsageEraser for removing a tenant, and dpop.ReplayCache (ReplayCache) for DPoP proof ids shared by every replica of a verifier. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/pgstore/migrate`](storage.md#package-migrate) | `pgstore` | [Storage](storage.md) | Package migrate creates and upgrades the schema pgstore's stores query. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/pgstore/migrate/ddl`](storage.md#package-ddl) | `pgstore` | [Storage](storage.md) | Package ddl is pgstore's schema as data: the migrations, the SQL that creates the version table before them, and the grants after, for a consumer that applies them with a migration tool of its own (docs/adr/0011-migrations-as-data.md). |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/otelmetric`](observing.md#package-otelmetric) | `otelmetric` | [Observing](observing.md) | Package otelmetric wraps a meter.UsageStore in OpenTelemetry instruments: charge, settle, refund, reservation and request-count measurements, by outcome and unit, and a capability's spend after each charge. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/limestest`](conformance.md#package-limestest) | `limes` | [Conformance suites](conformance.md) | Package limestest holds a consumer's mapping of limes's errors to the error contract it was written against (docs/compatibility.md). |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/storetest`](conformance.md#package-storetest) | `limes` | [Conformance suites](conformance.md) | Package storetest checks a limes.Store — and, when it is one, a limes.BiscuitRevocationStore — against the module's contract, the way testing/fstest checks an fs.FS. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/metertest`](conformance.md#package-metertest) | `limes` | [Conformance suites](conformance.md) | Package metertest checks a meter.UsageStore against the module's contract — its Meter, tenant budgets and housekeeping — the way testing/fstest checks an fs.FS. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/dpop/dpoptest`](conformance.md#package-dpoptest) | `limes` | [Conformance suites](conformance.md) | Package dpoptest checks a dpop.ReplayCache and a dpop.Nonces against the package's contract, the way storetest checks a limes.Store. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/jwks/jwkstest`](conformance.md#package-jwkstest) | `limes` | [Conformance suites](conformance.md) | Package jwkstest checks a limes.KeyResolver against the module's contract, the way storetest checks a limes.Store. |
| [`github.com/oleg-tkachuk/limes/exchange/exchangetest`](conformance.md#package-exchangetest) | `exchange` | [Conformance suites](conformance.md) | Package exchangetest holds a SubjectVerifier to the contract the Exchanger relies on, for an implementation of your own: one for opaque tokens through introspection, or for a provider whose tokens are not RFC 9068's. |
